featured_reviews.name: gauri langote
featured_reviews.review_text:
Chandika Devi Mandir, Dapoli: A Spiritual Retreat

Chandika Devi Mandir, located in Dapoli, Maharashtra, is a revered temple dedicated to Goddess Chandika, an incarnation of Goddess Durga. The temple sits amidst scenic surroundings, offering a peaceful atmosphere for devotees and visitors. The idol of Goddess Chandika is believed to be powerful and is worshipped for protection, strength, and spiritual well-being.

The temple’s serene location, surrounded by lush greenery, adds to its spiritual charm. It is a perfect spot for those seeking a spiritual retreat and a connection to nature, making it a must-visit for religious pilgrims and nature lovers alike.

featured_reviews.name: Jig M
featured_reviews.review_text:
Khodiyar Dham Temple, Naigaon

Visiting Khodiyar Dham Temple in Naigaon was a deeply peaceful experience. Situated right along the highway, The darshan of Modheswari Mata was truly divine, filling our hearts.

However, as we walked around, it was clear that the temple is struggling to maintain its beauty and cleanliness. The space desperately needs the love and care of the community. With some dedicated volunteering and generous donations, this holy place could be restored to its full glory, ensuring it remains a sanctuary for countless devotees.

For anyone visiting, the temple offers a moment of connection with the divine. Let us come together to support and preserve this temple.

name: Shree Vishwanath Dham
description:
Shree Vishwanath Dham is a peaceful Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, established in 2025. The temple is built around a naturally formed Shiv-ling that was carefully preserved and developed into a beautiful Shiv Mandir by its owner and trustee, Chandan Agarwal.
Surrounded by nature and home to four sacred cows, the temple also has a dedicated Gaushala where Gau Seva (service to Mother Cow) is an integral part of values.
The temple offers a calm and spiritual environment for prayer, meditation, and devotion. The temple is open to everyone, and all devotees are warmly welcome to seek the blessings of Lord Shiva.
